hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT" | grep -qiE "Co-Authored-By:.*Claude|Co-Authored-By:.*Anthropic|noreply@anthropic\.com|Generated with \[Claude"; then echo "[git-workflow hook] WARNING: output contains a Claude/Anthropic co-author reference. If this was part of a commit, it must be removed before pushing." >&2; fi'
